output.situation: Ambulance response times are increasing in Downtown due to an unknown factor affecting emergency call volumes.

applicable_rules.quote: Mandate M-A3-COORDINATION — agent A3 (Emergency & crisis authority, modelled on NCEMA (incl. its Civil Defence Authority)). Coordinate the services needed to address potential risks (civil defence). Permitted action types: activate_crisis_coordination, share_information.
applicable_rules.why: To coordinate and potentially alert other relevant authorities about the increasing response times.

applicable_rules.quote: Mandate M-A3-INFORMATION — agent A3 (Emergency & crisis authority, modelled on NCEMA (incl. its Civil Defence Authority)). Obtain information from the competent and concerned authorities. Permitted action types: request_information.
applicable_rules.why: To gather more information about the cause of the rising response times.

output.why: Option O1 is to inform A3 about the ambulance response issues, while Option O2 involves deploying additional ambulances which could be a reactive measure if the issue is related to resource allocation.

messages.content: Notify about rising ambulance response times in Downtown

questions_to_adviser: What should be done first regarding the cause of the declining emergency call volumes?
